title: Write Testbench for Multiplexer
statement: Write a testbench for a 2:1 multiplexer module. The testbench should apply all combinations of the two inputs and select line, then print the selected output. The design should confirm the multiplexer behaves correctly for every vector.
behavior: Apply all four combinations of inputs with sel = 0 and sel = 1.
Check that output matches the selected input.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not alter the DUT interface in the testbench.
hint: Use sequential stimulus generation in the initial block.
